payload.claim: SoundGuys names ULT WEAR best overall under $200 with effective ANC in a compact foldable over-ear
payload.quote: Sony ULT WEAR are our best overall pick because they combine effective ANC, long battery life, and broad connectivity in a compact, foldable over-ear package.

payload.claim: ULT WEAR measured over 25dB attenuation above 80Hz
payload.quote: In lab testing they lasted 32 hours and 35 minutes and deliver more than 25dB of attenuation above 80Hz, making them well suited for commutes and travel.

payload.claim: ULT WEAR earned Best for Comfort recognition at SoundGuys
payload.quote: The ULT WEAR also earned Best ANC, Best Battery Life, Best Call Quality, Best Over-Ear Headphones, Best for iPhone users and Best for Comfort recognition.

payload.claim: ULT WEAR is bass-forward; app EQ can tame it
payload.quote: Our MDAQS assessment shows the ULT WEAR are bass-forward, so we recommend using the app EQ to tame the ULT button’s heavy bass boost.

payload.claim: Space One folds and feels lightweight
payload.quote: The headphones fold, feel lightweight, and include USB-C charging plus an auxiliary cable for wired listening when needed.

payload.claim: Space One lasted 42h57 with ANC on; adjustable ANC
payload.quote: In our testing the Space One lasted 42 hours and 57 minutes with ANC on, and the app offers adjustable ANC strength, wind-noise reduction, and a decibel meter for safe listening.

payload.claim: JLab ANC is respectable but not matching higher-end, 10-20dB under 700Hz
payload.quote: The headphones deliver respectable ANC for the price — reducing much commuting noise though not matching higher-end models, with measured 10–20dB cancellation under 700Hz — and the ear cups provide strong high-frequency isolation.

payload.claim: JBL Live 670NC is on-ear, not over-ear
payload.quote: The on-ear form factor makes them highly portable, and in lab testing they exceeded their advertised endurance, lasting 54 hours and 57 minutes.

payload.claim: Accentum has effective ANC for everyday environments, bass-forward, $189.95
payload.quote: Beyond sound, it brings a well-rounded feature set that includes effective active noise cancellation for everyday environments and an impressively long battery life that easily supports extended listening sessions.

payload.claim: XM5 launched at 380 GBP, above 200 budget
payload.quote: With the current market conditions, we have seen quite a few price rises across the industry, and the Sony WH-1000XM5 haven’t managed to escape a slight increase, coming in at £380 / $399 / AU$549.
Comfort levels are up there with the best and the Sonys deliver just the right amount of clamping force, so they feel secure without threatening to crush our ears.
They’re among the class leaders when it comes to isolating us from constant drones and noises within train and underground carriages.

Shop around online and your'e likely to find a discount which makes their engaging sound quality, impressive noise-cancelling, great call quality and comfortable fit a match for any rival at the money.

payload.claim: Space 2 pitched as best for comfort and battery
payload.quote: The soundcore Space 2 is the best choice if comfort and battery life are your top priorities.
Adaptive noise cancelling: Automatically adjusts the noise reduction level depending on whether you are indoors, outdoors, commuting or flying.

payload.claim: ANC works best on steady low-frequency noise such as train rumble
payload.quote: It works best on steady, low-frequency noise, such as train rumble, aircraft engines, traffic and air conditioning.

payload.claim: JBL 650BTNC ANC good but behind Bose/Sony
payload.quote: When it comes to giving you some peace, the noise-cancelling is good but not a patch on the Bose or Sony.

payload.claim: Bose QC Ultra cuts out more noise than XM5 but costs £450
payload.quote: We think the Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones are a little more invasive and manage to cut out even more noise, but the Sonys are still very good for the money.

payload.claim: Weight and soft cushions can matter as much as ANC strength on long train journeys
payload.quote: For office work, long train journeys and flights, lightweight design and soft cushions can be just as important as ANC strength.
